pixelArt.title: Create a pixel character
pixelArt.intro: Describe a character, pick a size and let it be drawn. Then click an animation – that turns it into a GIF.
pixelArt.promptHint: Short and clear, for example job, clothing and colours.
pixelArt.promptPlaceholder: Knight in blue armour with a red cape
pixelArt.uploadHint: Your own image is scaled down to the grid in the browser – pixel art stays exactly as it is. The animation keeps the colours and the look of the character, only the pose changes.
pixelArt.animationsHint: The animation shows the same character. The number of frames is in brackets.
pixelArt.animationsLocked: Draw a character first – then you can animate it.
